query: "Studies on military-affiliated directors and corporate governance, focusing on their impact on earnings management and audit quality in emerging markets, especially Pakistan. Research explores upper echelons theory, board connections, and innovative governance strategies related to accrual and real earnings manipulation from 2010–2022."

response.query: Studies on military-affiliated directors and corporate governance, focusing on their impact on earnings management and audit quality in emerging markets, especially Pakistan. Research explores upper echelons theory, board connections, and innovative governance strategies related to accrual and real earnings manipulation from 2010–2022.
response.answer: Military-affiliated directors in Pakistan have been linked to earnings manipulation and lower audit quality, according to studies on corporate governance. Upper echelons theory supports these findings, showing a connection between military backgrounds and governance practices. Research from 2010-2022 highlights innovative governance strategies in this area.
